note: The events this node accepts from any producer, including out-of-process ones (the PowerShell standby guard, the shelf puller). A name here is a promise the event can be fired and will be logged; the handler is a no-op because the record is the log line. State holds the metadata note about the same happening - the event says it happened, State says what it is now.

events.name: standby.yield
events.description: AI work appeared; the Idle Service (mining) was stopped to make room. Payload: {ref, ai}.

events.name: standby.resume
events.description: The card has been free past the grace window; the Idle Service was restarted. Payload: {ref, idleForS}.

events.name: standby.pin
events.description: The operator pinned the Idle Service up, so AI work will not displace it. Payload: {ref, pinned}.

events.name: shelf.pulled
events.description: A node pulled a shelf revision: files fetched, every one hash-verified. Payload: {ref, peerRev, fetched, refused}.

events.name: shelf.refused
events.description: A pull was refused: a file did not match its hash, so nothing was written. Payload: {ref, path, why}.

events.name: job.submitted
events.description: A job entered the Scheduler's book. Payload: {ref, jobId, service}.

events.name: job.done
events.description: A job left the book as done, failed or cancelled. Payload: {ref, jobId, status}.
